extracted.name: Peach Crisp with Canned Peaches
extracted.description: This peach crisp layers canned peaches under a crispy shortbread-like crust. If you like nuts, sprinkle pecans over top before baking.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Layer canned peaches in a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Mix flour, sugar, cinnamon, and salt together in a large bowl. Mix in butter until the mixture resembles pea-sized crumbs; sprinkle over peaches.
Bake in the preheated oven until topping is light golden brown, 30 to 40 minutes.
